cards.title: Acorn Avenue Errand Office Story Goal Path Card

cards.pocketLabelPrompt: Pocket label: write a broad folder label for this Acorn Avenue want and goal path: ____________________.
cards.quietOptionLine: Quiet option: fill only the want, snag, and pocket label blanks before adding the first try later: ____________________.
cards.takeHomeLine: Take-home line: restart this paper goal path later with one pretend acorn errand want: ____________________.
